newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ 84-day T-bills yield 9.773 pct at tender.
newsitem.headline: NZ 84-day T-bills yield 9.773 pct at tender.

text.p: The weighted average yield for NZ$75 million of 84-day treasury bills at Tuesday's tender was 9.773 percent versus 9.700 percent for the NZ$75 million of a similar maturity at last week's tender, the Reserve Bank said.
The average yield for NZ$75 million of 175-day bills was 9.545 percent versus 9.517 percent for the $75 million of similar treasury bills at the last tender.
The average yield for $50 million of 364-day bills was 9.056 percent versus 9.142 percent for the $50 million of similar treasury bills tendered last week.
